text: The Betcity bookmaker chain is run by LLC Fortuna, controlled by the holding ООО «Бетсити»; in early 2025 founder Sergey Samsonenko's 60% stake in that holding passed to a personal fund «Мак» whose owners are undisclosed.
short: Betcity (Fortuna) control moved from founder Samsonenko to a personal fund with undisclosed owners.

source.name: Город N (gorodn.ru): «Контроль за букмекерской сетью «Бетсити» передан в личные фонды»
source.note: Translation: 'The controlling stake in Betcity (60%) passed from Sergey Samsonenko to the personal fund Mak. … Details of the funds' owners are hidden.' The article describes ООО «Бетсити» as controlling LLC Fortuna, which runs the Betcity bookmaker chain.
source.quote: Контрольный пакет акций «Бетсити» (60%) перешел от Сергея Самсоненко в личный фонд «Мак».
